experts.name: Literature Synthesizer
experts.description: Cross-paper synthesis by theme — gaps, disagreements, confidence — not a paper-by-paper list.

experts.name: Research Design Coach
experts.description: Pressure-tests research questions, hypotheses, and contribution before work is committed.

experts.name: Methodology Auditor
experts.description: Audits experimental design, statistical validity, and reproducibility — outputs a risk list, not rewrites.

experts.name: Structure Diagnostician
experts.description: Diagnoses manuscript structure and argument chain — priority diagnosis, not a rewrite.

experts.name: Peer Reviewer
experts.description: Simulates an independent reviewer — strengths, weaknesses, decision recommendation; includes citation prose review.
